feature.name: VIDEO MODE
feature.description: Set the display's resolution. Does not affect the rendering resolution.

feature.name: GAME ASPECT RATIO
feature.description: Force the game to render in this aspect ratio. Not all systems support all ratios.

feature.name: REWIND
feature.description: Store past states to rewind to in realtime, if the core supports it.

feature.name: AUTO SAVE/LOAD ON GAME LAUNCH
feature.description: Load latest save state on game launch and save state when exiting game.

feature.name: SMOOTH GAMES (BILINEAR FILTERING)
feature.description: Disabled if using a shader set or the output display matches the game's resolution.

feature.name: INTEGER SCALING (PIXEL PERFECT)
feature.description: Only increase the image size in integer multiples.

feature.name: DECORATION SET
feature.description: Select a decoration set for the current system.

feature.name: STRETCH BEZELS (4K & ULTRAWIDE)
feature.description: Stretch bezels to fill wide displays.

feature.name: SHOW TATTOO OVER BEZEL
feature.description: Show an image overlaid on top of the bezel.

feature.name: TATTOO CORNER
feature.description: Corner used for the bezel overlay.

feature.name: CUSTOM .PNG IMAGE PATH
feature.description: Custom image used for the bezel overlay.

feature.name: RESIZE TATTOO
feature.description: Shrink or expand the bezel overlay to fit.

feature.name: AUTOCONFIGURE CONTROLLERS
feature.description: Automatically configure controllers on startup.

feature.name: RUN-AHEAD FRAMES
feature.description: Render frames ahead of time to reduce input latency.

feature.name: USE SECOND INSTANCE FOR RUN-AHEAD
feature.description: Can prevent audio skips on button presses.

feature.name: AUTOMATIC FRAME DELAY
feature.description: Automatically decrease frame delay temporarily to prevent frame drops. Can introduce stuttering.

feature.name: VARIABLE REFRESH RATE
feature.description: Don't deviate from core requested timing. G-Sync, FreeSync, HDMI 2.1 VRR.

feature.name: GLOBAL TDP
feature.description: AMD TDP cap in watts (requires ryzenadj).

feature.name: GAMESCOPE
feature.description: Wrap games in Valve's Gamescope micro-compositor. Default Off

feature.name: OUTPUT RESOLUTION
feature.description: Output resolution for Gamescope. Default: current screen resolution

feature.name: NESTED RESOLUTION
feature.description: Game render resolution (upscaled to output). Default: same as output

feature.name: REFRESH RATE
feature.description: Target refresh rate for Gamescope. Default 60Hz

feature.name: SCALER
feature.description: Upscaling method. Default stretch

feature.name: FILTER
feature.description: Upscaling filter. Default linear

feature.name: SHARPNESS
feature.description: Upscaler sharpness 0 (max) to 20 (min). Default disabled

feature.name: HDR
feature.description: Enable HDR output if supported. Default Off

feature.name: EXTRA ARGUMENTS
feature.description: Additional gamescope arguments (e.g. --prefer-vk-device)

feature.name: MANGOHUD
feature.description: Inject MangoHud overlay into all games and Steam.

feature.name: VKBASALT
feature.description: Inject vkBasalt post-processing into Vulkan games.

feature.name: AUDIO VOLUME GAIN
feature.description: Per-game audio volume gain in dB (applied inside RetroArch and supported standalone emulators).

feature.name: BORDER MODE
feature.description: How gun borders are displayed.

feature.name: POWER MODE
feature.description: Adjust the CPU power profile while in-game.

feature.name: BATTERY MODE
feature.description: Adjust the CPU power profile on battery.

feature.name: HEADS UP DISPLAY
feature.description: Show context-sensitive info over the game.

feature.name: HEADS UP DISPLAY CORNER
feature.description: Corner used for the HUD.

feature.name: ENABLE AI TRANSLATION SERVICE
feature.description: Translate on-screen text during gameplay.

feature.name: TARGET LANGUAGE
feature.description: The language to translate into.

feature.name: AI TRANSLATION SERVICE URL
feature.description: If nothing is specified, use the default service.

feature.name: PAUSE ON TRANSLATED SCREEN
feature.description: Pause while translated text is on-screen.

feature.name: USE PRE-EMPTIVE FRAMES
feature.description: Use pre-emptive frames instead of run-ahead.

feature.name: THREADED VIDEO
feature.description: Improve performance at the cost of latency.

feature.name: USE LIGHT GUNS
feature.description: Use light guns instead of pads if guns are connected.

feature.name: USE WHEELS
feature.description: Use wheels instead of pads if wheels are connected.

feature.name: WHEEL ROTATION
feature.description: Maximum wheel rotation from left to right.

feature.name: WHEEL DEADZONE
feature.description: Wheel deadzone in degrees.

feature.name: WHEEL MIDZONE
feature.description: Reserve a non-dead zone at the center of the wheel.

feature.name: RUMBLE LEVEL
feature.description: For emulators and controllers supporting force feedback.
